en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Musa Bin Ja’far Al Baghdady, from Jameel, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘You should begin at Mina with the slaughter before the shaving (of the head); but in ‘الْعَقِيقَةِ’ ‘Al-Aqiqah’ (offering for a new born child) with the shaving (of the head) before the slaughter’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Musa ibn Ja’far al-Baghdadiy from Jamil who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
In Mina’ begin with slaughtering before shaving, and in al-‘Aqiqah (offering for child-birth) begin with shaving before slaughtering the offering.’”
